title: After 10th: route map
sub: Every stream, its entrance exams and the jobs at the end

scenes.say: Finished Class 10? Here is your complete route map. We will follow every path, one by one: what you study, which entrance exam you write, and the jobs at the end.

After Class 10, there are six main roads. Four are Intermediate groups: M P C, Bi P C, the commerce groups M E C and C E C, and H E C. Each takes two years. The other two are a three year polytechnic diploma, and an I T I trade course of one or two years.
scenes.sub: After Class 10, there are six main roads. Four are Intermediate groups: MPC, BiPC, the commerce groups MEC and CEC, and HEC. Each takes 2 years. The other two are a 3-year polytechnic diploma, and an ITI trade course of 1 or 2 years.

scenes.say: Let's start with M P C: maths, physics and chemistry. The biggest road is B Tech. You write JEE Main, JEE Advanced for the I I Ts, or EAPCET for state colleges, and become an engineer. B Arch, through NATA or JEE Main paper two, makes you an architect. A B Sc leads to teaching, analysis and science. And the N D A exam by U P S C trains you as an officer in the Army, Navy or Air Force.
scenes.sub: Let's start with MPC: maths, physics and chemistry. The biggest road is B.Tech. You write JEE Main, JEE Advanced for the IITs, or EAPCET for state colleges, and become an engineer. B.Arch, through NATA or JEE Main paper 2, makes you an architect. A B.Sc leads to teaching, analysis and science. And the NDA exam by UPSC trains you as an officer in the Army, Navy or Air Force.

items: RGUKT IIITs in Andhra Pradesh and Basar, Telangana
No entrance exam: merit on Class 10 marks
scenes.say: There is also a shortcut. The R G U K T triple I Ts in Andhra Pradesh, and Basar in Telangana, take students straight after Class 10. It is a six year course: two years like Intermediate, then four years of B Tech. There is no entrance exam. Seats go on Class 10 marks, with low fees and a hostel.
scenes.sub: There is also a shortcut. The RGUKT IIITs in Andhra Pradesh, and Basar in Telangana, take students straight after Class 10. It is a 6-year course: 2 years like Intermediate, then 4 years of B.Tech. There is no entrance exam. Seats go on Class 10 marks, with low fees and a hostel.

scenes.say: Next, Bi P C: biology, physics and chemistry. For M B B S, dental and AYUSH courses, the one exam is NEET U G, and it leads to doctor and dentist jobs. Pharmacy goes through EAPCET, and leads to pharmacist and drug inspector jobs. Nursing seats come through NEET or a state entrance. And agriculture, through EAPCET, can lead to an agricultural officer job.

The commerce groups, M E C and C E C, lead to B Com and B B A. You join through CUET, or on Inter marks through DOST in Telangana and O A M D C in Andhra Pradesh. For chartered accountancy, you write the C A Foundation. C M A and company secretary have their own entry exams. And after your degree, CAT or I CET takes you to an M B A, and a manager's job.
scenes.sub: The commerce groups, MEC and CEC, lead to B.Com and BBA. You join through CUET, or on Inter marks through DOST in Telangana and OAMDC in Andhra Pradesh. For chartered accountancy, you write the CA Foundation. CMA and company secretary have their own entry exams. And after your degree, CAT or ICET takes you to an MBA, and a manager's job.

scenes.say: H E C, with history, economics and civics, leads to a B A degree. For five year law, you write CLAT for the national law universities, or LAWCET for state colleges. After a degree, a B Ed through EdCET, and the teacher eligibility test, makes you a school teacher. And with any degree, you can write U P S C or state P S C exams for officer jobs.
scenes.sub: HEC, with history, economics and civics, leads to a B.A. degree. For 5-year law, you write CLAT for the national law universities, or LAWCET for state colleges. After a degree, a B.Ed through EdCET, and the teacher eligibility test, makes you a school teacher. And with any degree, you can write UPSC or state PSC exams for officer jobs.

rows: Junior engineer in railways and departments
scenes.say: Now the polytechnic diploma. You join after Class 10 through POLYCET, and study for three years. After the diploma, E CET takes you straight into the second year of B Tech. Or you can work: S S C J E and railway J E exams hire junior engineers, companies and P S Us hire diploma trainees, and apprenticeships give you paid training.
scenes.sub: Now the polytechnic diploma. You join after Class 10 through POLYCET, and study for 3 years. After the diploma, ECET takes you straight into the second year of B.Tech. Or you can work: SSC JE and railway JE exams hire junior engineers, companies and PSUs hire diploma trainees, and apprenticeships give you paid training.

scenes.say: I T I seats are given on Class 10 marks, with no entrance exam. The course takes one or two years, in trades like electrician, fitter, welder and C O P A. With an I T I, you can write the railway assistant loco pilot and technician exams, power company lineman posts, and technician posts at P S Us, ISRO and D R D O. Apprenticeships are open too.
scenes.sub: ITI seats are given on Class 10 marks, with no entrance exam. The course takes 1 or 2 years, in trades like electrician, fitter, welder and COPA. With an ITI, you can write the railway assistant loco pilot and technician exams, power company lineman posts, and technician posts at PSUs, ISRO and DRDO. Apprenticeships are open too.

scenes.h: Example: Ravi wants to be an engineer
scenes.say: Let's take an example. Ravi wants to be an engineer. He has three roads. Road one: Inter M P C for two years, then JEE or EAPCET, then four years of B Tech. Road two: polytechnic. He writes POLYCET and studies a three year diploma. After that he can start working right away, or write E CET and join B Tech directly in the second year, finishing the same degree in three more years. Road three: a triple I T, where he gets in on Class 10 marks and studies six years. All three roads take about six years, and end in the same B Tech degree.
scenes.sub: Let's take an example. Ravi wants to be an engineer. He has three roads. Road one: Inter MPC for 2 years, then JEE or EAPCET, then 4 years of B.Tech. Road two: polytechnic. He writes POLYCET and studies a 3-year diploma. After that he can start working right away, or write ECET and join B.Tech directly in the second year, finishing the same degree in 3 more years. Road three: an IIIT, where he gets in on Class 10 marks and studies 6 years. All three roads take about 6 years, and end in the same B.Tech degree.

scenes.h: Example: doctor, or a quick job
scenes.say: Now two more examples. Priya wants to be a doctor. She takes Inter Bi P C for two years, writes NEET U G, and studies M B B S for five and a half years, including the internship. Her friend wants to earn quickly. He joins an I T I on his Class 10 marks, finishes a trade in one or two years, then does an apprenticeship or writes the railway loco pilot exam. He can be working as a technician in two to three years.
scenes.sub: Now two more examples. Priya wants to be a doctor. She takes Inter BiPC for 2 years, writes NEET UG, and studies MBBS for 5½ years, including the internship. Her friend wants to earn quickly. He joins an ITI on his Class 10 marks, finishes a trade in 1 or 2 years, then does an apprenticeship or writes the railway loco pilot exam. He can be working as a technician in 2 to 3 years.

rows: SSC GD · SSC MTS · Railway Group D · Post Office GDS · Army Agniveer
SSC CHSL · NDA · Railway NTPC · Agniveervayu · Police constable
RRB ALP · RRB Technician · Power company JLM
RRB JE · SSC JE · PSU diploma trainee
UPSC · State PSC · SSC CGL · Bank PO
scenes.say: Government jobs open at every step. With Class 10, you can apply for S S C G D, S S C M T S, railway group D, post office G D S, and Army Agniveer. After 12th, S S C C H S L, the N D A, railway N T P C, Agniveervayu and police constable. I T I and diploma open the technical posts. And a degree opens U P S C, state P S C, S S C C G L and bank P O exams.
scenes.sub: Government jobs open at every step. With Class 10, you can apply for SSC GD, SSC MTS, railway Group D, post office GDS, and Army Agniveer. After 12th, SSC CHSL, the NDA, railway NTPC, Agniveervayu and police constable. ITI and diploma open the technical posts. And a degree opens UPSC, state PSC, SSC CGL and bank PO exams.

scenes.say: Here is the full map again. Every road leads somewhere good. There is no wrong choice, only the one that fits you.

items: Which job do you want at the end?
Note its entrance exam and dates
scenes.say: To pick your road, start from the end. Which subjects do you enjoy, and which job do you want? Then follow the map back, note the entrance exam and its dates, and talk it over with your parents and teachers.
